title: England Over 40s Announce 2026 Performance Squad
summary: The England Over 40s Cricket management has unveiled the 50-man performance squad for the 2026 season, with a strong focus on preparation for the IMC World Cup in Guyana.

title: World Cup Preparations Intensify with Training Camps
summary: Players from the England Over 40s performance squad are undergoing rigorous training camps across the country as they fine-tune their skills for the upcoming World Cup challenge.

title: New Partnership with Local Cricket Clubs Announced
summary: England Over 40s Cricket is proud to announce new partnerships with several local cricket clubs, aimed at fostering grassroots development and engagement within the over 40s community.
